pages.text: A Switchgleam is an Arcane Gem formed from a purple-spectrum piece of $(l:items/shaped_quartz)Shaped Radiant Quartz$() in an asscher cut.$(br2)When activated, a Switchgleam will swap the positions of you and the entity you're looking at, at the cost of one point of charge.$(br2)While held, Endermen within 10
blocks will have their teleportation attempts absorbed.$(br2)To recharge a dun Switchgleam, allow it to absorb Enderman teleportation. Each teleport attempt absorbed restores three points of charge.
